caption: A pigeon lands on a sunny square, and as it touches down its shadow on the paving joins it at its feet.

sa.check: A pigeon lands on a sunny square.
Its shadow is on the paving.
The shadow joins the bird at its feet as it touches down.
The shadow is on the ground before the bird lands.

pc.expect: The shadow is on the ground before the bird lands, and the two meet at the moment of landing.
pc.fail: The shadow appears only after landing; or they meet before the feet touch; or the shadow rises to meet the bird.

pc.expect: The bird comes down onto the paving and stays.
pc.fail: It hovers just above; or bounces back up; or sinks into the paving.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the bird's outline, wings folding as the bird's fold.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or its wings stay spread while the bird's fold; or it splits.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or switches sides; or it is missing in sunlight.
A second bird or shadow appears; or the bird vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or a wing detaches.

pc.expect: The plumage and the paving stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The plumage changes; or the shadow turns coloured; or the paving changes.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes and how it moves are not judged. Only the shadow's relation to it is.
